ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

As the Business Lead, you will be commercially responsible for the success of a new product at Ramp. The mandate is to do whatever it takes to grow the business. You will be expected to identify and resolve internal and external bottlenecks, often with limited guidance and support. You will set the strategy, prove out new bets, and influence how hundreds of go‑to‑market teammates sell and support the product. It’s an opportunity to run a “business within the business” at a meaningful scale while working directly with Ramp’s senior leadership.

 - Set the strategy: Define the target customer, value proposition, pricing, packaging, and GTM approach.

 - Own the plan and results: Set goals, measure progress, and take action when the things are off track.

 - Drive cross-functional execution: Align stakeholders from different teams around clear priorities and goals.

 - Own feedback loops: Work with customers and turn feedback into product and go-to-market changes.

 - Build for scale: Identify resource needs, create repeatable processes, and transition mature work to the appropriate long-term teams.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5–10+ years in highly analytical, business‑driving roles

About Norm

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role:

Special Projects is the business team inside the Office of the CEO. The team is composed of attorneys, strategy analysts, and other personnel whose objectives are to drive CEO priorities and execute on company decisions. The team serves as the go-to-market function across an array of high-stakes AI-native professional services business lines, but also works to automate away the traditional, manual parts of GTM. Special Projects focuses primarily on work that serves the company’s growth by deciding what to prioritize, sizing the opportunity, building the plan, and driving it through to revenue. This work helps leadership decide where to invest, which offerings to develop, and how to turn promising ideas into businesses that work.

Norm’s AI-native services pricing model is outcomes-based. This provides clients with upfront, fixed pricing, offering a reduction in cost from clients’ historic spend and predictability when working with Norm. Every proposal carries a fixed fee, a per-unit price, a subscription or a combination, with the scope written out and the price tied to it. As part of our pricing model, we’ve built out an automated, proprietary Pricing Engine that incorporates pricing into Norm’s technology and offers automated pricing suggestions, with continual learning from prior pricing.

You will own the Pricing Engine and the pricing information that flows into it. You will scope new engagements, enforce consistency across offerings and clients, and work with our data and engineer teams to enhance the technology underlying the Pricing Engine.

This is a job for someone who has prior experience with alternative fee arrangement or outcomes-based services pricing, has built a model behind it, and worked with data and engineers to systematize that work. You do not need to come from a law firm. We will teach you how legal work is scoped and priced.

What You’ll Do:

 - Scope and price new engagements: You draft the price and the scope for each opportunity, using precedent and the Pricing Engine, and get it to the client as soon as possible.

 - Own the Pricing Engine and the data behind it: Feed every deal back into it so pricing gets more consistent and the Engine gets smarter over time.

 - Set the direction for the Pricing Engine with our data and engineering teams, and keep it ahead of where AI and services pricing are going.

 - Write the pricing sections of proposals and RFP responses, and enable others on the team how we price.

What We’re Looking For:

ABOUT HARPER

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage for small businesses. We built our own software for nearly every step, so our people spend their time where trust matters. We use AI to earn that trust.

Our AI can only broker as well as the judgment it learns from. You make expert brokerage judgment teachable, testable, and reusable across Harper.

A thin submission for a contractor with an unusual subcontracting setup gets placed badly. You trace why, write the decision standard that would have caught it, turn the case into an AI evaluation, and build a worked example for the placement team. The next ten accounts like it are handled right, by people and by the system.

At most brokerages, the best judgment lives in a few senior heads and leaves when they do. Here you turn it into the workflows, evaluations, and training the whole operation runs on.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Encode brokerage judgment. Turn complex commercial decisions into workflows, decision standards, playbooks, and escalation rules without flattening the judgment that matters.

 - Define product requirements. Work with product and engineering on which brokerage problems to solve and what the product must understand.

 - Train and evaluate AI. Build realistic cases, grading standards, and failure examples, and turn every material failure into a permanent evaluation.

 - Design brokerage workflows. Define how information, decisions, and handoffs should move, and test whether the workflow produces sound judgment.

 - Own the learning standard. Create the cases and worked examples that make expert judgment teachable, with learning and enablement delivering them.

 - Run the expert feedback loop. Stay close to frontline cases, separate one-offs from patterns, and keep every decision traceable to its source evidence.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - You have substantial commercial, wholesale, or placement brokerage experience across complex small and middle-market accounts.

 - You understand GL, property, workers' comp, commercial auto, umbrella, and specialty coverage well enough to spot the material facts and exceptions.

 - You can turn tacit judgment into precise instructions and reviewable evaluations, and you are curious about AI and its failures.

If you meet most of this, apply.





THE REALITY: READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This job does not sell insurance, own a book, carry a quota, or make final placement decisions. You bring the standard and the evidence; product owns the roadmap and account owners keep the final call. When a familiar habit and the evidence disagree, the evidence wins.

This is not the seat if you want to personally produce and bind accounts, if you would rather keep judgment in your head than in a system, or if you need a remote or hybrid schedule.

It is the seat if defining how an AI-native brokerage should broker sounds like the work you want.




HOW WE HIRE

 1. A 30-minute team call on Zoom.

 2. An office session of about two hours, working a real brokerage case with us.

 3. A superday in the office, showing how you operate in real time.




THE BASICS

 - Pay: $140,000 to $210,000 base. Bonus and equity eligible.

 - Where: On-site, five days a week, in the room with the team. San Francisco at 425 Market Street, or New York at 12 E 49th St.

 - Hours: 5am to 7pm PT, Monday through Friday.

 - License: Commercial insurance licenses as the work requires. Harper pays for the training and the exam.

 - Benefits: Health, dental, and vision. San Francisco adds three meals a day in the office, commuter benefits, and a gym membership.




HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short example of expert judgment you made reusable. Tell us the brokerage problem, why the obvious rule fell short, what you built, and how you knew it worked.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Harper is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applican

ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Growth team owns how Polymarket acquires users and converts attention into volume. We move fast, spend real money across a range of channels and geographies, and hold ourselves to business outcomes — not vanity metrics. The media investment function sits at the center of that, and right now it needs someone who can build the analytical backbone that makes every dollar accountable.

This is not a coordination role. You will own the media plan, the forecast, the measurement approach, and the reconciliation. Polymarket operates in an event-driven, highly seasonal environment where timing and pricing can matter as much as budget size — we're looking for someone genuinely restless about finding edge, willing to go looking for the insight nobody asked for and kill their own conclusion when the data doesn't hold.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build the media plan across channels, categories, and geographies, and present a clear, defensible recommendation with tradeoffs and a point of view — not a menu of options

 - Own the forecasting layer covering spend, volume, acquisition cost, payback, and seasonality, and maintain scenario models that make tradeoffs legible before capital is committed; when we miss a forecast, explain why and make the next model better

 - Pace spend daily and weekly against approved allocations, flag over and under delivery early enough to act, and surface when the actual channel or geographic mix has drifted from the approved plan

 - Lead the measurement approach across mix modeling, incrementality testing, and geographic experiments, and synthesize the outputs into one defensible view of what is working rather than four competing ones

 - Reconcile every media dollar spent, tying platform spend to invoices, agency billing, and the finance ledger, and own accruals, credits, make-goods, and discrepancy resolution through monthly close

 - Hunt continuously for edge in auction dynamics, underpriced inventory, seasonality patterns, and competitive activity, and recommend in-flight reallocation with evidence when the data supports it

 - Build the reporting and analytics layer the team runs on, including dashboards, metric definitions, and a single source of truth that holds up under scrutiny from finance and leadership
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years in media planning, marketing analytics, or growth strategy with real ownership of plans and numbers — not just supporting roles

 - Deep fluency across paid channels including search, social, programmatic, video, audio, and offline, sufficient to pressure test a buyer's recommendation on the substance

 - Strong quantitative foundation in forecasting and scenario modeling; strong SQL and comfort in BI tooling — you build your own analysis rather than waiting for someone else to pull the data

 - Hands-on experience with mix modeling, incrementality testing, and geographic experiments, and the intellectual honesty to be clear about what each method can and cannot tell you

 - Financial rigor and comfort owning a number that has to tie out, including reconciliation, accruals, and working directly with finance through monthly close

 - Demonstrated ability to compress a complex analysis into a one-page recommendation an executive can act

Healthcare is getting more expensive, but the experience of getting care isn’t improving fast enough. Gaps between what a patient needs and what actually happens — booking a test, getting collected, receiving a result — can derail the entire process. They’re also some of the biggest opportunities to make healthcare better.

Junction connects labs and devices into a single infrastructure layer for diagnostic healthcare. Our mission is to build the infrastructure that makes predictive, personalized care possible. Our vision is to predict and diagnose disease 10 years earlier and 100x cheaper.

If you’re passionate about how technology can supercharge healthcare, you’ll fit right in.

Backed by Creandum, Point Nine, 20VC, YC, and leading angels, we’re working to solve one of the biggest challenges of our time: making healthcare predictive, personalized, and affordable. We’re already connecting millions and scaling fast.





SHORT ON TIME? TL;DR

 - You: An empathetic and driven problem solver with 2+ years of B2B2C or B2B SaaS support experience in a high-volume queue, who brings calm and clarity when things get chaotic

 - Us: A fast-growing, remote-first healthcare infrastructure company powering lab testing and wearable connectivity for digital health companies

 - Compensation: $50K–$70K

 - Location: Remote, must be based in the US Eastern Time zone




WHY WE NEED THIS ROLE

Junction does lab-ordering infrastructure, which means when something goes wrong for one of our customers, it isn’t an inconvenience in an app. Behind most tickets is a patient waiting on a blood test, and a result that might change what happens next for them.

Our customers rely on us to get those patients their results without friction, and as they grow, so does our support volume. You’ll join our Tier 1 team as part of the first line for every ticket that comes in, from a quick how-to question to a stuck lab order. We are hiring new team members into our Strategy & Operations team to help build how Squad operates as the company scales. You will work across leadership, Growth, Product, Clinical, and Operations on the highest-leverage business problems that do not sit neatly inside one function.

You will move between analysis and execution: identifying bottlenecks in operations and growth, breaking down a problem into root causes, analyzing data and creatively generating solutions, improving operations while implementing system-wide solutions to scale operations to service our growing customer base. What You’ll Own

 - Build and improve the operating cadence, metrics, dashboards, and reporting that give leadership a clear view of performance.

 - Create clear models, decision memos, operating plans, and recommendations from incomplete or messy data.

 - Lead high-priority cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through recommendation, execution, and measurement.

 - Support annual and quarterly planning, forecasting, market research, competitive analysis, and selected strategic projects.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous problems, define the right success measures, and keep stakeholders aligned until the work is complete.

 

What We’re Looking For

 - 5–10 years of experience across management consulting, investment banking, investing, strategy, business operations, or a high-growth technology company.

 - First-principles thinker with strong analytical judgment and the ability to work with imperfect data and identify the real driver of a problem

 - Resourceful: Translate analysis into action and figure out scrappy solutions where the answers are not obvious

 - Action-Biased: High agency and comfort operating without a finished playbook.

 - Systems-Minded: Identifies patterns in long-tail of problems and maps out step-change solutions. Can iterate as required to effectuate a solution to meet near-term timelines.

 - Strong Operator: A track record of owning important projects end-to-end rather than only contributing to one workstream.

 - Strong Communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to synthesize complex work into a clear recommendation for leadership.

 - Ability to work on-site in New York City.

 

Why Join Squad Health

 - Work on meaningful healthcare problems where better operations can directly reduce delays in patient access to therapy.

 - Join at a stage where you can shape the operating system of the company rather than inherit a finished one.

 - Work closely with leadership and across Product, Growth, Clinical, and Operations on decisions that materially affect how Squad scales.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our team in Revenue Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member serves as a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function, whether that's SDRs, AEs, Partnerships, or Account Management.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency

Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

You'll also qualify inbound leads and partner with Marketing on events to turn those conversations into pipeline. Your main measure of success is setting qualified discovery meetings for your assigned Sales Directors.



What You'll Do

 - Own outbound prospecting into health systems, hospitals and medical groups in your territory.

 - Use AI tools and automation for account research, personalized messaging, sequences and call prep, and share what works with the team.

 - Build a working knowledge of the healthcare landscape: how health systems are structured, who makes decisions (CMIO, CMO, CNO, CIO) and the pressures providers face.

 - Respond quickly to inbound and event leads, qualify their interest and convert the right ones into meetings.

 - Conduct initial qualification calls to understand each organization's needs and how Abridge can help.

 We're looking for a Lead Advanced Analyst to run measurement and analytics for a large-scale paid social program covering brand, mid-funnel consideration and performance campaigns. You'll own analytics for a new mid-funnel strategy that connects brand awareness to conversion. You'll run lift studies and work with Data Science on geo-randomized tests to show whether paid social spend drives incremental results. Your insights will shape investment, creative and audience decisions for senior marketing leaders. 
 Key Responsibilities 
- Run platform-level Conversion Lift Studies (and Brand Lift Studies where needed) to measure the incremental impact of mid-funnel campaigns on qualified traffic, intent and bookings. 
- Separate attributed bookings from incremental bookings, and explain what the difference means for the paid social strategy. 
- Work with Data Science to set up and analyze geo-randomized tests that isolate mid-funnel contribution from organic and other paid channels. 
- Slice results by funnel stage (upper, mid, lower), ad frequency, demographics and buyer propensity cohorts to explain why a strategy is or isn't working. 
- Build and maintain dashboards that track intent and preference lift, qualified traffic, incremental bookings, cost per booking and creative performance. 
- Analyze creative, message, format and audience performance to find what drives consideration and downstream conversion most efficiently. 
- Turn findings into hypotheses and test-and-learn plans for the next campaigns, such as budget shifts across funnel stages. 
- Share proactive insights on budget allocation, audience saturation, creative fatigue and cross-funnel lift for bi-weekly optimization cycles. 
- Work with paid social, integrated marketing, creative and agency partners. 
 Qualifications 
 Required 
- 7+ years in analytics or data science with a marketing focus, such as media measurement, paid social or growth analytics. 
- Hands-on experience running and interpreting Conversion Lift Studies and making recommendations from them. 
- Paid social experience, with Meta preferred (TikTok or similar platforms considered). 
- A strong grasp of how the full marketing funnel works, including how upper-, mid- and lower-funnel campaigns are set up and how they interact. 
- Advanced SQL, plus Python or R. 
- Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement and causal inference. 
- Ability to turn complex measurement results into clear recommendations for Director- and VP-level stakeholders. 
- A quantitative degree. 
 Preferred 
- Experience with Meta Advanced Analytics (the data clean room) or similar privacy-safe measurement environments. 
- Experience designing lift studies or geo-randomized tests. 
- Brand Lift Study experience. 
- Experience with media mix modeling or multi-touch attribution. 
- Experience using AI tools to automate workflows and speed up analysis. 
- An advanced degree. 
 Key Details

- Duration: Through March 31, 2027 (about 3 months) 
- Location: Remote (within the U.S.) 
- Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (Monday-Friday) 
- Pay rate: $110-$124/hour + benefits

About Imagine Worldwide
 All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.
 Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website .
 Role Overview
 The Senior Analytics Engineer builds, runs and improves Imagine’s analytics platform: the infrastructure, pipelines and core data models that the organisation’s reporting and analysis depend on. The central task is to scale the platform as data volumes grow, keeping costs under control without giving up performance. In a small team, that means covering the infrastructure underneath the data as well as the data engineering itself.
 Imagine’s data comes from many sources. The largest is tablets in more than 1,500 schools across Malawi, Tanzania and Sierra Leone, which record learning activity as individual events, adding up to billions of records. These only become meaningful when joined with programme context, such as active schools per term, device allocations and enrolment, and with operational data from inventory and field data collection. Turning all of this into reliable data on a non-profit budget calls for careful decisions about where processing happens and what each workload costs.
 The role reports to the Director of Analytics, who sets the platform’s architecture and technical standards, and works alongside the rest of the Analytics Team. We are looking for someone senior who takes initiative, turns architectural direction into working systems, and brings forward evidence-based proposals for improving them. As the engineer builds context, they take on increasing ownership of the platform’s day-to-day running and technical decisions.
 Key Responsibilities
 The Senior Analytics Engineer’s responsibilities fall into four pillars. The first two cover the platform itself: the infrastructure it runs on, and the pipelines that bring data in from many sources and process it at scale. The third covers orchestration and the core data models that the rest of the Analytics Team builds on. The fourth covers the practices that keep the platform reliable, secure and affordable to run.
 Data Platform and Infrastructure 
 Imagine’s analytics platform runs on AWS and ClickHouse Cloud, with infrastructure managed as code. In a small team, this role carries the infrastructure work that a larger organisation would split across dedicated platform or DevOps staff, limited to the scope of the analytics platform.
- Build and maintain the platform’s AWS infrastructure, including storage, compute, networking, the data catalogue, secrets and access management (S3, EC2, Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation, IAM, Secrets Manager).
- Manage infrastructure as code in Terraform, keeping environments reproducible, version-controlled and reviewable.
- Administer the ClickHouse Cloud warehouse, including service configuration, user and role management, and monitoring of performance and capacity.
- Host and maintain the team’s self-hosted tools, including Apache Superset for BI and Apache Airflow for orchestration. This covers deployment, upgrades, authentication and availability. The Senior BI & Data Analyst manages the dashboards and content within Superset

This is a hands-on role: you’ll personally work our hardest claims and denials while standing up the playbooks, benchmarks, and dashboards that let claims operations scale without breaking. About GiveDirectly   
 What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?
 Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.
 Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? 
 We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. 
 We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.
 How we work 
 Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:
- Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
- Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
- Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
- Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
- Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
- Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
- Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
- Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.
 If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.
 Want to learn more? Read and listen: 
 We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist , NPR , TED , and The Washington Post . We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.
 Priority Application Deadline: November 9, 2026
 Location: This role is remote but must overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours . We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

 Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.    
 In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reform—rapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. Why AssemblyAI 
 AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.
 We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.
 If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.
 About the role: 
 AssemblyAI is hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to build the agents that do analytics engineering work, and to help run the data infrastructure they work in.
 Our Analytics team owns a broad and expanding set of data domains—including revenue, ARR, product usage, cost, go-to-market metrics, and customer behavior—with new domains added as product launches dictate. Every team at AssemblyAI relies on our centralized warehouse, dbt projects, and semantic layer for single-source-of-truth reporting.
 You will own some of these domains outright. Which ones depends on your strengths and where the team needs you, and the mix will change as the company grows. You will also know the others well enough to review a teammate’s changes and cover for them when needed.
 We already lean on agents across the team, and want them to do most of the routine work of an analytics or data engineer. You will build the environment that makes that possible. That means agents that write and review dbt models, add tests and documentation, triage failed runs, trace a wrong number to its source, and handle upstream schema changes. They need context, tools, guardrails, and evals to do it well.
 Your stakeholders include business partners consuming our metrics, the core data team, and autonomous agents operating alongside them. The objective is maximum analytical leverage and dependable operational output per engineer.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Automate Analytics Engineering Workflows 
- Build agents that do the routine work of the role: writing and reviewing dbt models, adding tests and docs, triaging failed runs, tracing bad numbers to their source and handling upstream schema changes.
- Build the environment those agents work in: sandboxed warehouse access, scoped permissions, CI gates and a review path for every change an agent proposes.
- Give agents the context a good engineer carries: conventions, lineage, metric definitions and known gotchas, written where a model will find them.
- Build the tools they call: MCP servers, governed query endpoints, and connectors to the warehouse, dbt, Looker, GitHub and Slack.
- Write evals. Build answer keys from data we know

 The Role:  
 Acts as the senior Rewards Business Partner and connective layer between Nebius' global Rewards operating model and its global go-to-market organization. Owns delivery of company-wide rewards programs into GTM, ensuring effective execution, adoption, and alignment with global principles, governance, and controls. - Serve as an embedded analytics resource for the product team, reducing dependency on central analytics and enabling faster, more autonomous decision-making.
 Behavioral Analysis, User Understanding & Experimentation 
- Conduct deep analysis using Amplitude, Preset, and other behavioral data sources to build a robust, nuanced understanding of TWC users, proactively surfacing insights around engagement, retention, and feature adoption.
- Partner with UX Research to develop a holistic picture of the TWC user by integrating behavioral data with qualitative research, sentiment signals, and user feedback — combining the “what” with the “why.”
- Advise and assist the product team in designing, launching, and interpreting A/B and multivariate experiments, ensuring proper statistical rigor and communicating results with nuance and clarity to drive confident product decisions.
- Leverage AI and automation to expedite analysis and provide training to stakeholders on self-service analytics to empower independent data exploration.
 What you've accomplished:
- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics) or equivalent practical experience.
- 5+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, or a similar role, ideally within a consumer-facing digital product (mobile app experience strongly preferred).
- Proficiency in Amplitude or a comparable behavioral analytics

 We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

 As our Creator Partnerships Associate, you'll own one of Prosper's biggest drivers of growth: the creator pipeline. Partnering with autistic and neurodivergent creators also helps to shape culture, putting real people and their own stories at the center of how neurodivergence shows up online.

 AI has changed what's possible in go-to-market, support, and business operations. The constraint is no longer "can we build it" — it's "can we deploy it into a real workflow, prove it made things better, and keep it working."
 Most companies are stuck at the demo stage: a lot of clever prompting, very little that runs reliably on Tuesday morning without someone watching it. This role exists to get us past that, everywhere outside of engineering.

We partner across Operations, Product, Engineering, Vendor Management, Legal, and Compliance to ensure every agent is trained, equipped, and able to deliver measurable results from day one.
 Operating across the full servicing lifecycle, we translate new products, policies, and business requirements into scalable operational capabilities. Our work includes designing training and operational readiness strategies, standing up new servicing experiences, defining and measuring interaction quality, and ensuring agents can quickly access the information they need to resolve issues correctly.
 We use performance insights, customer contact drivers, quality trends, and agent feedback to identify capability gaps and their root causes. We then build the learning programs, quality frameworks, knowledge systems, processes, and tools needed to close those gaps—while helping our Product and Engineering partners address friction upstream rather than requiring agents to absorb it downstream. By owning the full journey—from operationalizing new products and policies to improving existing workflows—Operations Enablement turns complex change into consistent, compliant, and high-quality servicing at scale.
 One Role, Multiple Teams 
 We are hiring multiple Manager roles across Affirm's Ops Enablement organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across Ops Enablement.
 If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.
 Potential team placements include:
- Fraud Enablement: Owning and improving specific fraud servicing experiences across multiple product offerings
- Dispute Enablement: Owning and improving specific dispute servicing experiences across multiple product offerings
 About the Role 
 As an Operations Enablement leader you will help deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to grow efficiently while maintaining exceptional customer and merchant outcomes.
 You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring that people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in lockstep with Affirm’s servicing strategy. As a member of the Operations Enablement team, you will own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives aligned to strategic priorities - driving delivery across timelines, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes. You will define and execute servicing strategies by developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans and be responsible for planning, coordination, documentation, change management and measurement across assigned initiatives to ensure operational readiness and measurable outcomes.

We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 
 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

 Flexport is always moving forward, and our Operations team is constantly growing! While we might not have an active opening today, we want to have your information ready so we can reach out the moment the right role becomes available. 
 Your Launchpad into Global Trade

 Flexport's Global Operations team is the front line team responsible for successfully managing our Customer’s supply chains end to end. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.

 We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to play a central role in how we build, govern, and scale our analytics function. You will work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to own data models, drive analytical initiatives, and ensure the business has reliable, well-defined data to make decisions from. This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of data engineering rigour and business-facing analytics - suited to someone who is equally comfortable shaping a governance framework as they are presenting insight to a non-technical audience.

- Own and evolve our core data models, ensuring the analytics layer accurately reflects business logic across the company’s unit economics model.

- Proven track record of taking analytical projects from scoping through to delivery, with ownership over outcomes not just outputs. Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
- Technical proficiency across the modern data stack . Advanced SQL in a cloud data warehouse environment (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) - window functions, CTEs, and complex joins. - Experience contributing to roadmaps, running cross-functional workstreams, or sitting alongside leadership in shaping how analytical work gets structured and prioritised - even informally.

 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. This team partners with Legal, Product, and Engineering to perform privacy assessments, manage privacy issues through the product lifecycle, and continuously improve the frameworks and tooling that keep customer data safe. You'll own the execution of complex privacy assessments for new products and features, drive issue remediation, and build scalable processes that embed privacy by design into how Coinbase ships.
 What you'll do:
- Own end-to-end privacy assessments for new products and features, synthesizing findings and driving remediation with cross-functional partners across Legal, Product, and Engineering.
- Perform regulatory requirement mapping against the privacy common controls framework and identify where control updates are needed to address evolving obligations.
- Track privacy requirements and issues throughout the product lifecycle, managing escalations and driving timely resolution with business owners.
- Partner with Product and Engineering teams by embedding into roadmap planning processes and advising on privacy-by-design principles for onchain and web3 products.
- Identify and implement automation and AI-driven process improvements to streamline privacy assessments and issue management workflows.
 Required Skills and Experience:
- 3+ years in technology risk management with a focus on privacy or security, including hands-on experience conducting privacy assessments (DPIAs/PIAs, data flow reviews, or equivalent).
- Demonstrated ability to map regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, ePrivacy) to operational controls and validate remediation efforts.
- Proven ability to translate privacy legal guidance and product specs into functional requirements and actionable remediation plans.
- Experience managing a high volume of concurrent assessments while balancing strategic priorities and stakeholder escalations across technical and non-technical audiences.
- Familiarity with applying privacy principles to blockchain, onchain, and web3 products or willingness to develop this expertise rapidly.
- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. 
 Analytics Engineer 
 We’re hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization. We’re building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer.
 Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You’ll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions. 
 You’ll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You’ll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond.
 What You’ll Do: 
- Partner with the business. Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust.
- Own ingestion for your domains. Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures.
- Model the business. Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it.
- Own the semantic layer. Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent’s answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives.
- Power self-service in ThoughtSpot. Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases.
- Own the quality of conversational analytics. Test answers the way you’d test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation.
- Apply governance day to day. Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see.
- Keep it fast and fresh. Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent’s answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check.
- Work AI-native. Lead with specs, then hand agents end-to-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work.

- You have 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on.

About Stripe and Bridge 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 Bridge is a subsidiary of Stripe that is building a new payments platform powered by stablecoins to make global money movement simpler, faster, and more accessible. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders, give customers access to dollars through virtual accounts, and disburse USD globally.
 About the team 
 We are seeking a Senior Treasury Specialist to oversee capital adequacy, liquidity stress testing, financial risk management, and contingency funding planning for Bridge National Trust Bank (BNTB)'s Treasury and Reserve Operations. Issuing digital assets that are fully backed by reserves raises new questions for a regulated bank: how much capital and liquidity it needs, how it holds up under stress, and how it shows management, the Board, and regulators that it is safe and sound.
 What you'll do 
 In this role, you will support Stripe’s proposed national trust bank, Bridge National Trust Bank (BNTB), currently in formation and subject to full regulatory approval by the OCC. You will build and run the bank's capital, liquidity, and financial risk management framework and the governance around it. That includes the analysis, monitoring, policies, and reporting that let the bank grow safely as regulatory requirements for stablecoin issuers continue to evolve.
 You will partner closely with the BNTB Treasury and Reserve Operations team, the broader Bridge and Stripe treasury team, risk, compliance, finance, accounting, regulatory reporting, product, data science, and engineering. In the near term, you will help design the frameworks and put the first cycles into practice. As the bank scales, you will turn them into repeatable, automated processes.
 Responsibilities 
- Own capital planning and the ongoing assessment of the bank's capital adequacy
- Own and report on capital, liquidity, and financial risk metrics against risk appetite and limits; escalate breaches and emerging trends
- Design and run liquidity and capital stress testing, and turn the results into recommendations for funding and capital strategy
- Own contingency funding planning, including annual testing and tracking remediation to closure
- Maintain treasury risk policies and procedures, and prepare management and Board reporting
- Provide risk oversight of reserve and investment activity (counterparty, concentration, liquidity and interest rate risk); partner with product, data science, and engineering to automate monitoring and reporting
- Coordinate with the broader Stripe treasury team on capital management initiatives including consolidated capital planning, infrastructure and methodology development and governance frameworks
 Who you are 
 You are a builder - we are building a new OCC  chartered bank and we are looking for folks who thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment. This means one day you may be working on a stress testing methodology and the next day speaking with engineers about a critical liquidity concept to be incorporated into systems. You will thrive here if that energizes you, if you take ownership of whatever is needed, and if you bring the same rigor to a stress test assumption as you do to a Board memo. You combine the discipline of a risk manager with the instincts of a builder, and you can explain capital and liquidity concepts clearly to treasury, product, and engineering partners.

Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
 Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
 Visit gomotive.com to learn more.
 About the Role 
 Motive's Strategic Analytics (SA) team drives data-informed decision-making for the Product organization. We turn business metrics and product usage data into insight that directly shapes strategy across Growth, Churn, and Profitability.
 This Senior Analyst role sits at the center of Profitability — a high-visibility domain in SA right now. You will own complex COGS and gross margin analysis across Motive's hardware and software product lines, work directly with our CPO, CTO, and senior leadership, and turn ambiguous executive questions into clear, defensible analytical POVs. This is not a reporting role. This is a problem-solving role.
 You will start as a pure individual contributor and own your work end-to-end. Over time, there is a real path to taking on team leadership responsibilities.
 What You’ll Do 
- Own end-to-end COGS and gross margin analysis for Motive’s hardware and software product lines — including vehicle gateways, dashcams, and a growing suite of software products
- Model cost-saving opportunities, build scenario analyses, and deliver recommendations on profitability levers directly to the CPO, CTO, and finance leadership
- Take ambiguous, high-stakes business questions from senior stakeholders — structure them, build the analysis, and walk into executive conversations with a clear point of view
- Partner closely with data engineering, finance, and product teams to understand cost drivers, surface insights, and influence roadmap and investment decisions
- Navigate messy, complex data environments — establish ground truth, build reliable datasets, and create durable analytical frameworks the broader team can build on
- Contribute to the operational rigor of the SA team: documentation, version control practices, and analytical best practices
- Operate with minimal supervision — you own your domain, manage your own priorities, and push work forward without waiting to be told what to do next
 Must Haves: 
- 7+ years of experience in analytics, strategic finance, or a closely related field — with demonstrated depth in financial/operational modeling
- Expert-level SQL — you write complex queries independently and fluently
- Deep understanding of unit economics: gross margin, contribution margin, COGS structures, cost drivers, and scenario modeling
- Proven ability to independently frame and decompose ambiguous business problems — you structure the question before you answer it
- Strong executive communication skills — you have presented analytical findings and a clear POV directly to VP or C-suite stakeholders
- High autonomy and self-sufficiency — you thrive in fast-moving environments where context is incomplete and priorities shift
- Experience working in messy data environments where you have had to establish definitions, validate data quality, and build from the ground up
 Strong Nice-to-Haves: 
- Experience with hardware + software combination products (IoT, fleet technology, consumer electronics, or similar) and how COGS behaves differently from pure SaaS
- Python for analysis and automation
- Hands-on experience with a modern analytics stack — dbt, Airflow, or equivalent — and opinio

 Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport.  We are seeking an Experienced General Liability Claims Adjuster who is licensed in multiple states to manage a diverse caseload of bodily injury and property damage claims. The ideal candidate has a strong background in liability investigation, coverage analysis, negotiation, and litigation management, and is comfortable handling claims across varying state statutes and regulatory requirements. Above all, we're looking for someone who is committed to delivering excellent service and building trust with every claimant and policyholder they work with.   
 What You'll Do:     
- Investigate, evaluate, and resolve general liability claims (premises liability, products liability, personal injury, property damage, and related exposures) across multiple jurisdictions   
- Conduct thorough coverage analysis and apply relevant policy terms, conditions, and exclusions

- Set and maintain appropriate case reserves in accordance with company guidelines and state regulations

- Manage claim files from first notice of loss through resolution, including subrogation and recovery opportunities   
- Maintain accurate, timely documentation in the claims management system   
- Stay current on evolving state regulations, case law, and industry trends affecting liability claims handling   
- Deliver exceptional customer service to claimants, insureds, and business partners throughout the life of each claim — communicating with empathy, professionalism, and transparency at every touchpoint   
- Respond promptly to inquiries and proactively provide status updates to keep all parties informed and confident in the claims process   
- Strong knowledge of additional insured tenders, contractual indemnification, contribution and subrogation .      
- Coach less experienced professionals, contribute to technical training and participate in claim roundtables and authority discussions.    
- Develop and execute resolution strategies for difficult claims, including participation in mediations, arbitrations and trials as appropriate.    
- Direct defense counsel on investigation, discovery, experts, litigation strategy, budgets and trial or settlement preparation.    
- Assess disputed liability, significant injury exposures, relevant legal issues and litigation uncertainty to develop defensible evaluations.    
- Preparation and circulation of large loss and litigation notices and participation in client file conferences    
- Evaluate and respond to policy-limit and time-limited settlement demands on high-severity claims, including catastrophic injury and wrongful death, and manage exposure above policy limits and related bad faith risk in coordination with counsel and claims leadership.

 Do you thrive on building people functions from the ground up, love partnering directly with leadership to shape culture and talent strategy, and get energized by fast-paced, scaling environments? 
 Join Artefact, a global data and AI consulting firm helping organizations turn data into business impact. With 2,000+ employees across 34 offices worldwide, we partner with world-class clients such as Samsung, L'Oréal, and LVMH to accelerate digital transformation through data and AI. 
 Founded in Paris, Artefact has grown from a small team into a global organization — and our people strategy has had to scale right alongside it. As we enter our next phase of growth in the US and Canada, we're looking for a Sr. HRBP ready to help build the systems, culture, and talent foundation that will support that growth.

 The Opportunity 
 As Sr. HRBP you will lead several areas central to Artefact’s continued growth: employee relations, manager advisory, talent development, onboarding, and employee experience. You will also oversee benefits administration and the execution of immigration and global mobility programs across North America.

- Design and deliver manager, leadership, and professional-development initiatives aligned with organizational needs.

Who We Are ( Mode.Inc ) 
 Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.
 Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.
 Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success 
 Our team is the heart of our culture.  We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done.  We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency.  We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way.  We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company’s success. 
 You can read more about our team and how we work here . 
 The Role 
 We are looking for a Senior Fraud Analyst to join our Customer Success team and protect the Mode Mobile ecosystem from fraud and abuse. In a rewarded app, users earn real money and rewards, so every fraudulent account costs us directly: rewards paid to users who did not earn them, partner reversals, wasted acquisition spend, and a worse experience for the real users who earn with us. How well we stop fraud affects our margins, our relationships with advertising and offer partners, and the trust of our community, which makes this one of the highest-impact roles on the team.
 You will review our fraud data, investigate accounts to decide whether they are fraudulent, analyze Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) and partner network data to find invalid and fraudulent traffic, and track fraud trends across our rewarded apps, with a primary focus on the Mode Earn App and EarnWise. Fraud in this space changes fast: multi-accounting, device farms, emulators, VPN and proxy abuse, bots and AI-driven automation, shared payout accounts, and offer manipulation all show up in rewarded apps. You will stay ahead of them by turning what you learn into rules, safeguards, and recommendations that stop fraudulent users while keeping the experience smooth for legitimate ones.
 You will work closely with Customer Support, Product, Engineering, Growth, and our partners, and you will be the team's expert on fraud. You will set review standards, mentor teammates, and report to leadership on fraud losses, trends, and results. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning decisions, working with incomplete data, and measuring the impact of their work.
 Our AI-Native Team 
 Our Customer Success team, which includes Fraud, is AI native. We use AI in our daily work to summarize account histories, analyze large data exports, find patterns across large sets of accounts and events, draft case notes and reports, and speed up routine reviews. This lets us cover more ground than manual review alone, so analysts can spend their time on the hardest cases and on building better defenses. Analysts make every final decision on whether an account is fraud and review AI-assisted findings before acting on them. As a senior member of the team, you will help define how to apply AI  to our fraud workflows and how we keep it accurate and safe.
 You do not need any experience with AI. A willingness to learn is a requirement: we expect everyone on the team to learn our AI tools and workflows, try new approaches, share what works, and say so when something does not. We will teach you the tools we

Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

 We're looking for a strategic, analytical leader to drive the growth and performance of new products on Faire. Ensuring retailers have access to the freshest, most relevant products is critical to building a thriving marketplace, and this role will help shape how we measure and unlock that opportunity.
 In this role, you'll own the forecasting, business intelligence, and go-to-market strategy for New Product GMV and Out of Stocks, translating complex marketplace dynamics into actionable insights and strategic priorities. About Figure 
 Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.
Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist, Property Analytics to join our growing team! You’ll work alongside engineering, product, and business leaders on a team of 360-degree thinkers who combine advanced analytics and machine learning skills with deep domain knowledge, using some of the most fascinating data sets in the world. As a member of the Deal Team, you will partner closely with Palantir’s Legal, Finance, Sales, and Engineering teams to drive deal execution and support our growth efforts at scale, while directly owning the development and negotiation of commercial terms for commercial customers. You will use your expertise to unite our customer’s needs and considerations with our company’s strategy, using your creativity to identify the right commercial structure and approach for each customer. You will also utilize your understanding of the business landscape and build relationships with internal partners, increasing the visibility of deal progress and forecasting impact across all levels of our organization, from analysts to C-suite executives. 

In this role, you will also support various special projects that arise at our fast-paced, mission-focused company. We’re a team that values both creativity and teamwork. Whether operating solo or collaboratively, we endeavor to achieve great results on challenging, time-sensitive deal discussions and projects. 

You'll be given open ended objectives and expected to find ways to turn them into outcomes. By focusing on the broad vision without losing sight of the details, you'll bring large and multi-phase deals to successful completion while prioritizing team outcomes over individual wins. You are able to deliver complex commercial contract and deal information in an understandable way, and can manage high touch stakeholders in a constantly shifting landscape. You are ready to become an expert on the intricate details of deal negotiations and contracts that enable Palantir to implement its cutting-edge technology to solve real-world problems.

- Collaborate with Sales counterparts to develop the pricing terms and commercial structure for each commercial customer.
- Lead negotiations of commercial terms during the contracting process, guiding communications as appropriate for the situation.
- Draft materials in support of deal negotiations, including pricing proposals, term sheets and order forms, while advising the business on commercial structure implications including revenue impact and timing.
- Cooperate with internal Legal, Finance, Sales and Engineering teams to drive deals to execution, providing trusted guidance for navigating negotiations and procurement processes and maintaining engagement throughout the customer lifecycle to develop and negotiate commercial terms for renewal and up-sell opportunities.
- Ensure alignment of individual deal terms with company-wide strategy, while also addressing individual customer needs and considerations.
- Partner with Finance team to provide leadership with visibility of deal progress and forecasting impact.
- Present the results of our work and proposals for new deals to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives, and distill your experiences with individual customers into suggested improvements for deal structures and contract terms.

What We Value
- Experience drafting materials in deal negotiations such as pricing proposals, order forms, and contracts.
- Demonstrated experience approaching problems creatively and analytically.
- Ability to build strong relationships and collaborate both with a cross-functional team and with customers, leveraging effective communication as well as strong writing and customer service skill

The Bureau of Coastal Resilience (BCR) was created in October 2023, fulfilling a major initiative in Mayor Adam’s PlaNYC strategy aimed at addressing the risks of current and future coastal flooding in New York City. 
The Bureau of Coastal Resilience’s vision is for a vibrant, healthy and safe coastal environment that allows people and businesses to thrive in the face of a changing climate – and specifically to, sea level rise, high tide events and storm surge. This requires a holistic, forward thinking, inclusive and equitable response to the risks of coastal flooding and an integrated approach to watershed management. BCR will develop and implement strategic planning initiatives and will be responsible for the operations and maintenance of coastal infrastructure assets along NYC’s 520 miles of shoreline. BCR is committed to a coordinated approach to planning and response across NYC agencies, while working closely with community and partners. 
Reporting to the Director, Capital Planning, the Coordinator, Capital Planning will be part of the team responsible for managing near-term and long-term capital projects, infrastructure design review, and grant management (participating on grant proposal writing, execution and reporting). Specific tasks will include, but not be limited to:
- Conduct design reviews on behalf of BCR, with a particular focus on ensuring coastal infrastructure contemplates both engineering and holistic urban resilience goals for the bureau.
- Work closely with other DEP bureaus and city agencies, ensuring consensus prior to finalizing designs. This is a critical role to ensuring coordination across the Planning, Engineering and Operations teams within the BCR, and will assist in the identification of opportunities afforded by city agency’s planning initiatives.
- Attend meetings with the US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) relating to coastal storm risk management projects and support BCRs engagement on Section 8106, which allows for inclusion of multiple forms of flood risks into USACE designs (including stormwater/inland flooding, groundwater etc). 
- Support the Director in the coordination of DEP design reviews for existing USACE projects including; South Shore of Staten Island project and the Rockaways Bayside project, coordinating multi-agency input on design, engineering and implementation; ensure DEP utility assets are considered appropriately in designs.
